review.tagline: Chat interface that answers with generated interactive UI, charts, maps and tools
review.summary: A Next.js and CopilotKit chat frontend backed by a Python Deep Agent (FastAPI). For each turn the agent returns text, a native component, or custom HTML/CSS/JS streamed into a sandboxed iframe. A router model (Jev) picks A2UI for basic tables and Open Generative UI for charts, diagrams, calculators and maps. It is meant to be cloned and adapted rather than used as-is.
review.audience: Developers building chat products that render generated interactive UI
strengths: Generated UI runs in an isolated iframe with a validated host bridge for follow-ups
Visitors can supply their own keys, held in browser memory only, not storage
Optional standalone MCP server with HTTP, stdio and Docker configuration
MIT licensed, with a documented architecture and launch verification workflow
weaknesses: Needs both an OpenAI key and a TYPESAFE_API_KEY for the Jev router
Provider failures are surfaced; no fallback to another model or router
Output varies per run because the router chooses the presentation
Setup needs Node 22+, pnpm 9+, Python 3.12+ and uv; no release published
needs: Needs OpenAI API, Jev router (TYPESAFE_API_KEY), Node.js 22+, pnpm 9+, Python 3.12+, uv
